SHOT: Extreme macro, 4:5, of the two clusters facing each other on the broad, heavy gold band: the pear and the round on one end, the two pears with their points turned outward on the other, the thick gold blocks under them and the row of tiny gold beads, resting on the top face of a cream plaster cube. Camera very close; the piece fills about two thirds of the frame; razor-sharp on the stones and the metal edges, the rest falling softly out of focus.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority for the plaster, the background and the light only.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN CLUSTER RING with a BROAD, HEAVY polished gold band, about 5 to 6mm wide and about 2mm thick, solid and chunky like a wide cigar band, exactly as IMAGE 1 and IMAGE 2 show, that does NOT close. Each open end is squared off and rises into a thick gold block that carries a small cluster of clear faceted stones in raised gold claws; the two clusters face each other across a narrow gap. One end carries exactly TWO stones: ONE clear PEAR, the larger, and ONE SMALLER clear ROUND, lined up end to end. The other end carries exactly TWO stones: two clear PEARS of the same size side by side, their rounded ends together and their points turned outward, with a row of tiny gold beads along the edge of the band beside them and nothing else. All stones clear. Only clear stones: one pear and one round on one end, two pears on the other; never coloured stones, never a full pave band, never a closed band. Exactly FOUR stones in all: three pears and one small round; never five stones, never four pears, never two rounds. The end with the round has one round and one pear, never two rounds; the end with the two pears has no third stone, not even a small one.

SCALE TEST: Each cluster is about 10 to 12mm across: the pears about 5x7mm, the round about 4mm; the band is about 5 to 6mm wide, nearly as wide as a pear is long, and about 2mm thick.

LIGHT: Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no ear, no model, no fabric, no props. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.

SHOT: A worn photograph: the model's hand raised and resting lightly on her collarbone, the WHOLE hand in frame, all its fingers and the wrist, the ring a small accent on one finger in true proportion to the hand. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on the RING finger only, the fourth finger from the thumb, beside the little finger. ORIENTATION TEST: the ring finger points straight UP the frame, and the marquise's long axis and the molten bar BOTH lie HORIZONTALLY, LEFT TO RIGHT, at right angles to the finger, like two rungs of a ladder across it, side by side and parallel to each other; the bar's one end lies over the neighbouring finger and its other end just past the ring finger's other edge; neither ever points along the finger toward the fingertip or the knuckle; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING with a BOLD, WEIGHTY look, exactly as IMAGE 1 shows: a polished gold band that does NOT close, its two open ends side by side on top of the finger, both running in the same direction as the band. At one end ONE LARGE clear MARQUISE-cut faceted stone, about 5.5 x 11mm, in four strong gold claws, its long axis following the band. The band's other end becomes ONE long, CHUNKY molten gold BAR: a solid, glossy, organic rod, gently wavy like poured metal, about 2mm thick along its length and swelling to rounded droplet ends about 3mm across, about 25mm long. The bar is THICK: about a third of the marquise's width, a bold rod that carries one long bright highlight down its length. The marquise sits beside the lower half of the bar, and the bar's upper half rises well past the marquise's tip. The marquise and the bar lie side by side and parallel, both in line with the band; on the finger both lie ACROSS the finger. Exactly one stone, a clear marquise, never round, oval or pear; no pave, no halo; the bar is smooth polished gold with soft ripples, never a straight machined bar, never thin like a wire, never set with stones; the band does not close. The band NEVER crosses behind the marquise and the bar at right angles: never a cross or plus shape.

SCALE TEST: On the finger the marquise is about two thirds of the finger's width long; the bar is about one and a half finger widths long, running across the ring finger and on over the neighbouring finger, and about a tenth of the finger's width thick: a bold rod, never a wire. Never larger than this. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.
